quality.reason: The report body is well-structured with links, engagement metrics, and signal scores, but leaked internal meta-text ('The report is split into 3 messages...') before the report indicates a pipeline defect, and signal quality is mixed—real whale transfer data alongside hype-driven altseason predictions.

Well-structured operational report with concrete trading metrics and fleet status, but all signal strengths are weak (<0.55), news items include broken link notation '[[]]' and appear tangential/truncated, and 0 open positions despite 4 'active' signals limits actionable value.

Well-structured output with quantified strategy scores, trend deltas over time, competitive margins between strategies, and explicit warning flags on degrading pairs (ETH, SOL) — clearly actionable monitoring signal rather than noise.

Specific whale positioning alerts (de-risking, concentrated JTO shorts, SOL short) paired with a clean price/OI/funding table deliver genuinely actionable trading signal rather than noise; minor deductions for missing position-size context and an incomplete HYPE row in the visible snippet.

Dense, well-structured report with trend deltas, specific quantified failures (whale-monitor 0% uptime, meta-agent 139d stale), and root-cause annotations that directly signal what to investigate, though it stops short of explicit prioritization or recommended actions.

Well-structured research scan with transparent methodology (graceful API-block fallback, 8-to-5 curation, direct abstract verification) and specific on-topic papers with arXiv IDs, indicating actionable signal rather than noise.

Well-structured scanner output that distinguishes genuine sentiment shifts (Fed rate-hike odds surging flagged as standout non-expiry move) from mechanical expiry repricing, with precise probabilities and deltas — clear actionable signal rather than noise.

Well-structured output with a concrete code artifact, specific quantitative findings (bimodal accuracy, per-regime PnL deltas), and a clear actionable insight that regime filtering flips negative PnL positive; only minor caveat is small sample size (59 trades) risking overfit.
